hypothesis: Large three-day negative moves may contain temporary overreaction recoverable before a short fixed timeout. Tested separately on BTC/ETH;daily horizon is an unproven extension of intraday reversal research,and liquid-coin momentum evidence is a contrary prior.

time_boundaries.state: One cold cash start per configuration at OOS start,no imported spring-summer positions,no interfold resets;carry actual cash,units and desired through the missing winter period.

data.format: Archived Binance spot 1m OHLCV; daily closes and quote ADV are aggregated from fully closed UTC days.

execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.
execution.percent_price: Check frozen PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE against preceding5 fully closed minute quote-volume/base-volume VWAP proxy. Historical reference-price regime is unavailable; proxy is explicitly an assumption, not historical exchange order validation.
execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. No L2, queue, latency, partial fills or guarantee IOC fills; MARKET_LOT_SIZE does not apply to simulated limit IOC.

costs.impact_inputs: Previous20 completed UTC day quote ADV and sample stdev20 log daily returns. Buy cash before costs is conservative notional upper bound; sell uses units*reference. Decimal sqrt of budget/ADV, sigma/ADV derived from existing lagged daily function.

rules.entry: At daily decision i,use only completed close j=i-1. If cash and C[j]/C[j-3]-1 strictly less than -D,attempt one full-cash spot buy at i00:01UTC. Equality does not enter;no crossing requirement.
rules.frozen_recovery: On actual filled entry at indexe,freeze pre-shock anchorA=C[e-4] and signal closeB=C[e-1]. Hold until a completed close satisfies2*C[j]>=A+B (half arithmetic price recovery),or i-e>=H complete daily execution intervals. No re-anchoring or moving target.
rules.exit: Check exits only when held at decision start;exit at next00:01OPEN,never at an intraday target or old close. An exit decision cannot reenter the same day,even if the current3dayloss still qualifies. Earliest reentry next daily decision.
rules.state: One cold cash start per configuration;carry actual cash/units,entry index,A/B across all12folds. Successful sell clears state;rejected order leaves actual state unchanged. No stop,averaging down,pyramiding or fold reset.
rules.allocation: Each config independent2000USDT in one spot asset. Raw maximum asset exposure1 via affordable lot,cash residue retained. No portfolio weighting/normalization,transfers,leverage,short,borrowing or cash yield. Original ongoingSMA75/25 unchanged.
rules.terminal: OOSend is known in advance;allow normal late entries then costed terminal liquidation. Terminal truncation and entry index disclosed,not filtered using future outcome.

sensitivity: For each asset full D×H3x3. Inclusive adjacent-index neighborhoods within asset;all18configs/54costs/648folds disclosed,no OOS choice or adaptive grid extension.
validation: 365dayinitial historicalcontext plus3daygap;12continuous30dayfolds. Fixed causal rules,no fitting/futurelabels,purgeNA. Reused developmenthistory,not untouched finaltest. NoDSR/PBO orliveprofitclaim.

NAV_axis.definition: Initial cash;each day predecisionnativeOPEN and postdecisionnativeOPEN (duplicates allowed),then1440originalFloat64closedminute marks;end preterminalOPEN and costed liquidation. Preserve pre-fill gap peaks;do not rewrite old metric conventions.

sources.scope: DeNicola2021 author journal abstract reports1/2/4hournegativeautocorrelation and stronger large-move reversals. Our3dayentry/half-recovery/timeout is a separately tested extension,not replication.
Zarembaetal2021 indexed author abstract distinguishes illiquidcoinreversal from largest/liquidcoinmomentum. Directpage403 recorded;contrary prior,not support for BTC/ETHdaily reversal.
Current official definitions;actualexecution uses originalfrozenOct1historical proxy snapshot.

limits: Daily meanreversion in two highlyliquidcoins may be absent;do not infer edge from trigger size.
Downside unconstrained until close-based recovery/timeout;no intraday stop,no independently untouched finaltest.
